help: stage a manifest and its payload: the manifest moved from where the download left it, each file it lists downloaded by navigating Safari to its one-use export_url - the export page fetches a signed storage URL and Safari takes the download, unpacking it where it opens safe files - and deposited into the data-* directory sharing the manifest's star (manifest-<X>.json beside data-<X>/); refused if that directory is staged or held

args.name: --manifest
args.help: the manifest, wherever the download left it - required: each export_url is one-use, so no default picks one

args.name: --to
args.help: stage under a directory instead of the stage (test escape hatch - a directory, never a machine name)

x: --manifest <file> (consumed: moved into the stage as the unit's record)
~/Downloads (where Safari puts each download, under the server's name, replacing a same-named entry; moved out on arrival)

osascript: drives Safari against the logged-in session - fronting claude.ai in a work tab, navigating it to each export_url, reading the page (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
navigation to each export_url (Safari): the export page asks claude.ai for a signed storage URL and Safari downloads from it; each URL is one-use, so the navigation consumes it (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
